design_gotchas.title: CRITICAL SOT-23-5 Pinout Mismatch vs TLV9001IDBVR, TLV9061IDBVR, OPA333AIDBVR, and TLV3201AIDBVR
design_gotchas.detail: LMV321IDBVR uses the classic LMV321/SC-70 SOT-23-5 pinout (1=1IN+, 2=GND, 3=1IN-, 4=OUT, 5=VCC+), permuting pins 1, 3, and 4 relative to TI standard DBV parts TLV9001IDBVR, TLV9061IDBVR, OPA333AIDBVR, and TLV3201AIDBVR (1=OUT, 2=V-, 3=IN+, 4=IN-, 5=V+). Direct substitution shorts the output into the noninverting input—use TI's U-variant (e.g., TLV9001UIDBVR) for pin-matched RRIO upgrades.

design_gotchas.title: Zero Supply Headroom Above 5.5 V (Abs Max = Operating Max = 5.5 V)
design_gotchas.detail: Section 6.1 specifies 5.5 V as the absolute maximum VCC—identical to the 5.5 V recommended maximum—leaving zero margin for 5 V rail overshoot or unregulated USB surges, unlike TLV9001IDBVR (7.0 V abs max) or TLV9061IDBVR (6.0 V abs max). Short circuits from OUT to VCC can also cause permanent thermal destruction.

design_gotchas.title: Rail-to-Rail Output Only — Input Common-Mode Clips 1.0 V Below VCC+
design_gotchas.detail: While output swings within 10 mV typ of VCC+ into 10 kΩ, guaranteed common-mode input range stops at VCC+ - 1.0 V (0 to 4.0 V on 5 V; 0 to 1.7 V on 2.7 V). Unity-gain buffers driven above 4.0 V on a 5 V rail saturate and distort; use an RRIO U-variant such as TLV9001UIDBVR when full-rail input swing is needed.

design_gotchas.title: High Bipolar Input Bias (15 nA Typ / 250 nA Max) and 7 mV Max Offset
design_gotchas.detail: LMV321IDBVR draws 15 nA typ (15,000 pA; up to 500 nA over temperature) input bias current with 7 mV max room-temperature offset (9 mV over temp), making it unsuitable for MΩ sensor bridges or high-precision low-side shunts where CMOS pA-bias amplifiers excel.

typical_use_cases: Cost-sensitive 3.3 V and 5 V single-supply MCU ADC buffers and active filters on LMV321 SOT-23-5 footprints
Compact consumer appliance, HVAC, and telecom power-module signal conditioning (-40°C to +125°C)
Low-voltage rail-to-rail output single-channel alternative to legacy LM358 half-sections
General-purpose ground-sensing low-side current and voltage monitoring with 1 MHz GBWP
engineering_summary: The Texas Instruments LMV321IDBVR is a general-purpose, low-voltage (2.7 V to 5.5 V), rail-to-rail output single operational amplifier in a 5-pin SOT-23 (DBV) package rated from -40°C to +125°C. Delivering 1 MHz GBWP, 1 V/µs slew rate, 130 µA typical supply current, and ±40 mA short-circuit drive without Class-B crossover distortion, it is a staple in budget 3.3 V/5 V boards. Crucially, its SOT-23-5 pinout (1=1IN+, 2=GND, 3=1IN-, 4=OUT, 5=VCC+) is NOT pin-compatible with TLV9001IDBVR, TLV9061IDBVR, or OPA333AIDBVR (1=OUT, 3=IN+, 4=IN-), and its 5.5 V absolute maximum supply rating leaves zero headroom above 5.5 V.

audit_notes: Visually verified LMV321 SOT-23-5 (DBV) Top View pinout on 300 DPI PNG page 3 (Figure 5-2 & Table 5-2): 1=1IN+, 2=GND, 3=1IN-, 4=OUT, 5=VCC+ — explicitly confirmed permutation mismatch vs TLV9001/TLV9061/OPA333/TLV3201 DBV.
Verified Abs Max (5.5 V, TJ=150°C), Recommended Operating (2.7 V–5.5 V, -40°C to 125°C), and LMV321 DBV RθJA = 232.9 °C/W on page 5 PNG (Section 6.4).

Verified Section 6.7 (2.7 V) and Section 6.8 (5 V) Electrical Characteristics on pages 6-7 PNGs: converted IIB = 15 nA -> 15000 pA, confirmed single-channel LMV321I ICC = 130 µA typ at 5 V (80 µA at 2.7 V).
